mentions.name: Ur
mentions.description: A universal formatter and linter for every programming language, currently in preview. It reimagines the Rascal meta language in Rust with features from JastAdd, and is incremental and persistent between runs thanks to Mambo, a library that replaces Salsa and persists all queries to disk. It also includes static analysis and code rewriting tools that were developed in tandem with a mass rewrite of parts of the Rust compiler.
mentions.source_excerpt: Ur is an (very in-progress) universal formatter and linter for every programming language. It's in preview right now, which just means friends are messing around with it and having a good time pointing out all the bugs. Docs are mostly up to date, but buyer beware. Implementation wise, it's the Rascal meta language reimagined in Rust with some features from JastAdd thrown in there for good measure. Ur is incremental/persistent between runs, it's built on top of Mambo, a library that drops in as a replacement for Salsa and persists all queries to disk automatically.
mentions.author: knuckleheads
